CustomField.label: UID
CustomField.description: MIAW visitor UID parsed from the messaging JWT sub (the uid: segment). Serves as the upsert key linking a pending asset-context row to the MessagingEndUser.MessagingPlatformKey, so the session-create trigger can find the pending Asset regardless of arrival order.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Visitor UID from the MIAW JWT (matches MessagingEndUser.MessagingPlatformKey after the uid: prefix).
